newsitem.title: THAILAND: Siam Commercial Bank to issue bonds.
newsitem.headline: Siam Commercial Bank to issue bonds.

text.p: Shareholders of Thailand's Siam Commercial Bank Plc on Monday approved a plan to issue long-term bonds worth a total of 47.75 billion baht ($1.84 billion) in foreign markets, the bank's president said.

The first tranche of bonds amounting to 8.75 billion baht ($336.5 million) will be issued within this year in the form of subordinate debentures with a 30-year maturity, company president Olarn Chaiprawat told reporters.
The second tranche of 30-year bonds worth 39 billion baht will be floated over the next three to five years under the bank's medium-term note programme, Olarn said.
Olarn said the downgrade of the bank's credit rating by Standard and Poor's is expected to raise its borrowing costs by only 0.3 basis points.
S&P earlier this month downgraded Siam Commercial Bank's credit rating to BBB-plus/A2 from A-minus/A2.
